name: Feature Exposure & Gap Resolution
description: Expose hidden features, implement missing commands, fix broken integrations, enhance user interfaces, and update all documentation. This phase addresses the critical gap where 50%+ of implemented features have zero user accessibility. Phase now includes comprehensive README updates for all modules.

tasks.name: Security Audit and Hardening
tasks.modelRationale: CRITICAL: Security audit requires highest reasoning and security expertise.
deliverables: ✅ Full security audit — 13 findings (1 Critical, 4 High, 6 Medium, 2 Low)
✅ CRITICAL-01: Path traversal fix in handleGetFile() (../.. attack prevention)
✅ HIGH-01: IP spoofing fix — X-Forwarded-For gated by AQT_TRUST_PROXY env var
✅ HIGH-02: Security headers added (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, removes X-Powered-By)
✅ HIGH-03: urlencoded body size limit added (1mb cap)
✅ All critical/high findings resolved — production clearance GRANTED
✅ Security audit report created at docs/SECURITY-AUDIT-REPORT.md
✅ Deployment checklist with production environment variables documented
tasks.notes: Production clearance granted. 1 critical (path traversal) + 4 high (IP spoofing, missing headers, missing body limits) fixed. 6 medium findings documented as accepted risk. Audit report at docs/SECURITY-AUDIT-REPORT.md.
